propositions: Gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml run repo scripts without if-present guards, causing hard-fail (exit 2) when the script is absent from a checked-out patchset's tree.
Gerrit's Verified lane uses the workflow definition from the target branch but checks out the change's tree, so steps added on main fail against open changes branched before those scripts existed.
Nine unguarded gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and two in gerrit-verify.yaml golden-path job run Python scripts that exit with FileNotFoundError instead of skipping gracefully.
Each gate step must carry an early-return guard that skips with a log line when the script is absent, matching the pattern used in the Git version floor gate fix.
A structural enforcement check must fail if a step in a patchset-lane workflow (using checkout-gerrit-change-action) runs a repo script without an if-present guard to prevent future instances.
